meta.description: A software studio that designs, builds and runs digital products, our own and for clients.

home.tagline: We design, build and run digital products, our own and for clients.
home.intro: You work directly with the people doing the work. Systems built to grow, not one-off pages.

items.title: Consulting and assessment
items.body: We listen to how your business runs: we talk with you and, when needed, with other areas of the business, because each one sees a different part. We review processes, tools and data; we strip out what's redundant and repeated so everything runs leaner and faster, and we automate or handle with AI whatever makes sense. You get a written report with prioritized improvements and a step-by-step plan, with scope and timeline. It works on its own or as the first step of a build.

items.title: Custom development
items.body: Platforms, internal systems and websites that go beyond a single page: they connect with what you already use and are built to grow. Turnkey: we handle the domain, email, hosting and launch, and you get a user guide and technical documentation. Every site includes the essentials: mobile-ready design, speed, basic SEO, security, backups and a privacy policy.

items.title: Operations and maintenance
items.body: After delivery we stay on it: security, updates and adjustments, on a monthly plan.

featured.title: Your gallery online, easy to maintain
featured.body: Catalog, artwork pages with high-quality images and purchase inquiries, in multiple languages: English, Spanish, Portuguese and any others you need. You add a new work in minutes, without depending on anyone. Built on the same foundation as The Art Lab Galleries, and ready to issue certificates of authenticity with dCOA.

items.name: dCOA
items.summary: Digital certificate of authenticity for artworks.
items.problem: Paper certificates get lost, get copied and don't record whose hands a work has passed through.
items.solution: We built a complete platform: passwordless sign-in, artwork registry, certificate issuance, public verification by QR code, transfers between artist, gallery and collector, and timestamping that proves the record hasn't changed.

process.title: How we work

steps.title: Scope and timeline
steps.body: Together we define what you need and by when. The timeline sets the pace of the work and the payment schedule. We don't bill by the hour. If you need it sooner, it can be done: the work is more intensive and the price is higher.

steps.title: What we agree, in writing
steps.body: We work from a concrete list of features. If something new comes up, we estimate it separately and you decide whether to add it, with its cost and timeline.

steps.title: Payments tied to deliveries
steps.body: A first payment to start, and the rest against something you can see working.

steps.title: One meeting a week
steps.body: Thirty minutes: what got done, what's next and what changes you'd like, always with something working to show. Afterwards you get a written summary.

steps.title: After delivery
steps.body: We stay on it with a maintenance plan: security, updates and adjustments.

process.note: In-house development, using the same technologies software companies use: no templates and no site builders. Your system can grow without platform limits.
